title: Verify: Character schema, animation resolver and preload unit tests
description: Test schema, resolver, planPreload and BootScene with Phaser mocked.
acceptance_criteria: Resolver returns manifest animation or idle
BootScene plays idle then interact with mocked Phaser
technical_constraints: Phaser mocked via the @game alias pattern in bootScene.test.ts

Build the manifest from game/public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json via parseManifest.
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/characterAnimation.test.ts
